describes: Anthropic Admin API GET /v1/organizations/cost_report response saved as JSON (bucket_width=1d, group_by[]=description and group_by[]=workspace_id). Money only: no token quantities.

sources.covers: data[].starting_at/ending_at (RFC 3339, bucket start inclusive, end exclusive, UTC snapped), results[].amount ('Cost amount in lowest currency units (e.g. cents) as a decimal string'), currency ('Currently always USD'), cost_type (tokens|web_search|code_execution|session_usage|null), model, token_type (uncached_input_tokens|output_tokens|cache_read_input_tokens|cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens|cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens), workspace_id, description; bucket_width only 1d

provenance.notes: model, token_type and cost_type are null unless group_by[]=description is requested; without it every row is UNKNOWN (kept, not matched). The amount is in CENTS: divisor 100 converts to USD exactly.

timestamps.note: RFC 3339 values carry their offset (Z); no declaration needed.
